name: Margaret Sutton
quote: After 14 years of green seawall, I had given up. Platypus had it looking new in 48 hours. Genuinely kind crew.

name: David Reyes
quote: They sent a real plan with photos before I paid a cent. No upsells, no surprises. House looks 10 years younger.

name: Karen & Tom Albright
quote: We were nervous about chemicals near our garden. Platypus walked us through every product — everything came back greener, not deader.
